title: fix(metadata-protocol): a flow read's _diagnostics and the restore doors judge a stored flow in its D2-converted spelling
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ85ZKppiwDrpyUp1d2RvAzUX)_
Fixes #29696

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:流程的读取 `_diagnostics`(单项、列表、`?layers=true`、草稿读取、诊断汇总)的 schema 判定,以及两道恢复门(`rollbackMetaItem`、`revertCommit`)的运行时规则,改为按 D2 转换后的拼写判定流程,与保存门、两道发布门同一条缝 `storedFlowVerdictBody`;返回与恢复的仍是存储原字节。
- 为什么改:旧拼写的流程行(如 get_record 的 `filters`)保存、发布、引擎注册都能过,读取却标 `valid: false`,恢复历史版本则被 422 拒掉,同一行几处答案不一。
- 风险与回滚:只放宽(转换后仍不合格的行照旧 `valid: false`、恢复照旧被拒,错误与新拼写一致);回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`metadata-diagnostics.ts` 的 `computeMetadataDiagnostics`(读取判定入参)、`protocol-authoring-gate.ts` 的 `refuseRestoredBodyTheSaveDoorRefuses`、`protocol-flow-save-replay.ts` 的 `storedFlowVerdictBody` 注释(转换链与引擎一致的实测说明)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/protocol.draft-publish-verdict.test.ts src/protocol.restore-doors-save-refusal-family.test.ts -t 29696`,预期 9 条全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **The read's schema half.** `computeMetadataDiagnostics` judges a `flow` through `storedFlowVerdictBody` (the seam the save door's fallback verdict and both publish doors judge through, PR #29694). Every read exit that decorates reaches it: `getMetaItem` (active and draft), `getMetaItems`, `getMetaItemLayered` and the `getMetaDiagnostics` sweep. The read serves the body it was handed; the converted body is the verdict's only. Not a redaction, so the #8154 order in `decorateMetadataItem` is untouched (the body judged is still the unredacted one; no flow redactor or cleartext-credential refusal exists in the flow schema).
- **The restore doors.** `refuseRestoredBodyTheSaveDoorRefuses` (both `rollbackMetaItem` and `revertCommit`'s restore limb) hands the runtime authoring rules `storedFlowVerdictBody(type, body)`, as `promoteDraftForPublish` does for a flow draft. The version is restored as stored; the credential read and every other refusal in the family read the stored version. The restore doors still do not ask the schema gate (its docblock's stored-shape reason stands).
- **The excluded conversion, settled in the docblock.** Measured: the engine's rehydration (`canonicalizeFlow` in `service-automation/src/flow-definitions.ts`) replays the full chain with retired entries and excludes `CONVERSIONS_NOT_REPLAYED_AT_REHYDRATION`, which names the same one id as `FLOW_FALLBACK_VERDICT_NOT_REPLAYED` (`flow-decision-mode-inclusive-explicit`). So `storedFlowVerdictBody` already replays exactly the engine's chain. `storedFlowVerdictBody`'s docblock now says so, says why the excluded entry never decides acceptance (it is a default flip: an omitted decision `mode` parses and means exclusive), cites the maintainer ruling (letter C on #15429) that it is not replayed over stored flows, and drops the old claim that `applyConversionsToStoredItem` replays this chain on read (no read converts a flow: `convertStoredItem` skips `flow`). No converter added; no conversion list changed.
- No `packages/spec` change.

## Why

A flow row at rest in a legacy ADR-0087 D2 spelling (`get_record` `config.filters`) is accepted by the save door, both publish doors and the engine, but its reads answered `valid: false` and both restore doors refused a history version in that spelling. Measured red on `origin/main` `0eb97fa4`, the pins committed first (`e905c02c`, fix not yet applied):

<details><summary>Red, before the fix</summary>

```text
× the active item read reads valid: true and serves the stored bytes
× the list read reads valid: true and serves the stored bytes
× the layered read reads valid: true            (first run: the double lacked registry.getItem; fixed in 3bf9be7c, red for the right reason in the ablation below)
× the draft read of a re-save of it reads valid: true
× a row still refused once converted reads valid: false, with the errors its canonical spelling reads
× rollbackMetaItem: answers INVALID_METADATA / 422; nothing is stored
× rollbackMetaItem CONTROL: an acceptable version of the same item is restored
× revertCommit CONTROL: the restore limb restores an acceptable version of the same item
Tests  8 failed | 1 passed | 84 skipped (93)
read:    { valid: false, errors: [ { path: 'nodes.1.config.filters', code: 'custom', ... get_record contract: Unrecognized key(s) ... `filters` } ] }
restore: Error: flow/acme_fetch failed author-time validation: 2 issues — flows[0].nodes[1].config.filters [expression-invalid]; flows[0] [flow-region-shape-invalid]
```

</details>

<details><summary>The excluded conversion, measured against the built spec (scratch probe, not committed)</summary>

```text
start → decision (two conditioned out-edges, no mode) → two ends
constructed raw valid: true
constructed stored-verdict chain valid: true mode: (omitted)
constructed full chain valid: true mode: inclusive
```

The flip changes meaning, never acceptance: no body is refused for want of it.

</details>

## Tests

- New top-level `describe('[#29696] …')` in `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.draft-publish-verdict.test.ts` (the #29557 harness; its legacy-flow fixtures are hoisted to module scope so both blocks share them). A legacy row seeded at rest: the active item read, the list read, the layered read and the draft read of a re-save each answer `_diagnostics: { valid: true }` and serve `config.filters` as stored. A legacy row that also carries an undeclared config key reads `valid: false` with exactly the `_diagnostics` its `filter` twin reads.
- New `pinBothDoors` case in `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.restore-doors-save-refusal-family.test.ts`: a legacy history version restores at both doors (the active row equals the history bytes, `filters` included); a legacy version that also carries an edge whose CEL does not parse is refused 422 `INVALID_METADATA` at both doors on `expression-invalid`, with nothing reported at `filters`, and stores nothing.
- The #29557 block's parenthetical saying the read's schema half still judged the stored body is replaced with a pointer to the new block.

<details><summary>Ablation (fix committed first at d2c880d5, mutated through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restored to the HEAD blob)</summary>

```text
leg 1: metadata-diagnostics.ts  withoutResolvedPicklistOptions(storedFlowVerdictBody(singular, stripReadDecorations(item)))  ->  withoutResolvedPicklistOptions(stripReadDecorations(item))
  × the active item read / the list read / the layered read / the draft read / a row still refused once converted
  Tests  5 failed | 4 passed | 84 skipped (93)
  ok restored: blob == HEAD (2125c9e92828) and git diff HEAD is empty
leg 2: protocol-authoring-gate.ts  body: storedFlowVerdictBody(type, body),  ->  body,
  × rollbackMetaItem refused / rollbackMetaItem CONTROL / revertCommit CONTROL
  Tests  3 failed | 6 passed | 84 skipped (93)
  ok restored: blob == HEAD (6fb69ae67c79) and git diff HEAD is empty
```

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The boot census in `protocol.ts` (`[metadata_spec_invalid] … fails the current spec schema even after conversion`) reads `computeMetadataDiagnostics` too, so a legacy D2 flow row no longer draws that warning: for a flow the sentence was false before (no read converts a flow), and the engine registers the row. Not separately pinned.
- A still-refused flow's `_diagnostics` error paths are located on the converted body, as the publish doors' issues are (#29557); for a key rename such as `filters` → `filter` the path of an unrelated finding is unchanged.
- `runAuthoringGate` (plugin-registered gates) on the restore path still receives the stored version. No in-tree plugin registers a `flow` gate (only `object`), and the publish promotion does not call it at all; left as is.
- `FLOW_FALLBACK_VERDICT_NOT_REPLAYED` and `CONVERSIONS_NOT_REPLAYED_AT_REHYDRATION` stay tied by prose only: neither is on its package's published surface, and metadata-protocol cannot import service-automation (the dependency runs the other way). Noted, not filed.
- PR template headings are folded into the os-dev section order.

## Verification

All readings on head `760e096f` unless named (the fix `d2c880d5` plus a test-only fixture-typing commit). `origin/main` moved 10 commits since the branch point `0eb97fa4`; none touches `packages/metadata-protocol` or the spec's conversion or automation sources, so no merge was taken.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol test`: Test Files 308 passed, 4 skipped; Tests 22277 passed, 26 skipped (lock VERDICT command-exit 0; run on `d2c880d5`). On `760e096f` the two touched test files: 2 files, 93 tests passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol typecheck`: exit 0 on `760e096f` (exit 2 on `d2c880d5`: a TS2352 cast in the new fixture, fixed in `760e096f`).
- `dispatch-gates --commands` on `760e096f`: 61 derived; `--ran` reconciliation: 60 run, 1 NOT MEASURED (`check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, exit 3 PREREQUISITE NOT MET: it reads every package's dist and this worktree built only the touched closure; CI runs it), 0 unrun. `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` first answered exit 3 (shallow clone lacked its pinned fixture commit) and exit 0 after `git fetch origin 621a4876`. `pnpm lint` exit 0.
